clips.title: The story
paras: The Princess Trapped begins when adventurers uncover an iridescent crystal shard in the Arathi Highlands and hear the plea of Myzrael, a self-styled princess of the earth imprisoned deep underground. Claiming she was trapped by hostile giants, she begs travelers to confront their kobold allies in Drywhisker Gorge and restore power to her crystalline communication network.

Scattered across the rolling plains of the Arathi Highlands, strange crystal shards hum with distant power. Approaching them reveals a desperate voice echoing from deep subterranean caverns: Myzrael, a self-proclaimed princess of the earth. She claims that ancient giants cast her down and bound her far beneath the soil, cutting her off from the sunlit lands above. The crystals embedded in the earth represent her sole means of contacting the surface, carrying her pleas for salvation to any adventurer willing to listen.

To maintain her tenuous contact and begin breaking through her subterranean isolation, Myzrael directs travelers eastward toward Drywhisker Gorge. The gorge is infested with Drywhisker kobolds, creatures she identifies as allies of her giant captors. These kobolds carry resonant Motes of Myzrael and guard a prominent cluster of iridescent shards. By wresting these motes from the kobolds and applying their energy to the formation, rescuers can empower the crystal cluster and deepen their communication with the trapped princess.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My name is Myzrael. I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the Arathi Highlands. These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world.

Please help me. Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker Kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east. To power the cluster, you must gather Motes of Myzrael from the kobolds and apply them to it.
I beg you, friend, aid me!
